name: Billion Context
description: Model-driven context compression: the model folds long histories into its own summaries, so one session keeps going instead of dying at the context window.
author: port of ranxianglei/billion-context (MIT)

en.name: Billion Context
en.description: Model-driven context compression: the model folds long histories into its own summaries, so one session keeps going instead of dying at the context window.
en.safetyNotes: Bundles billion-context-pi 0.1.83 (MIT) and runs it unmodified in the agent extension host, with the same trust as the agent. Adds compress / decompress / search_context / acp_status tools and /acp commands to the model. Summaries are written by the model. Fold state is stored under ~/.pi/agent/acp-desktop/. Nothing leaves the machine except the model calls you already make. Upstream's self-update is disabled; fixes arrive when the vendored copy is updated.

zh-CN.name: Billion Context
zh-CN.description: 模型驱动的上下文压缩：模型自己把长历史折叠成摘要，一个会话能一直跑下去，而不是在上下文窗口处死掉。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 内置 billion-context-pi 0.1.83（MIT），原样运行在 Agent 扩展宿主内，信任级别与 Agent 相同。会向模型注册 compress / decompress / search_context / acp_status 工具与 /acp 命令。摘要是模型写的。折叠状态存在 ~/.pi/agent/acp-desktop/ 下。除你本来就会发出的模型请求外不上传任何东西。上游自更新已关闭，靠更新内置副本来获取修复。
